# Synthetic smart-crop fixture

`synthetic_seated_person.jpg` and `synthetic_reclined_person.jpg` are 640x360
downsamples of images generated by OpenAI's built-in image generator on
2026-07-19 specifically for Media's automated smart-crop tests. They depict
fictional people and contain no customer media.

Prompt summary: one fictional adult seated upright and centered in a generic
living room, looking at the camera, with a visible face and full body, generous
empty room on both sides, no other people, face-like artwork, brands, text, or
watermarks. The second prompt used the same constraints with one adult reclining
horizontally across the couch while turning their unobstructed face toward the
camera. Both sources were generated as photorealistic 16:9 frames and reduced to
the detector's test resolution with FFmpeg.

The test suite shifts, rotates, and changes the exposure of these fixtures to
exercise the embedded CPU face detector and edge-containment logic without
shipping or depending on private reference media.
